required_behavior.device: one device class for all methods within a timed comparison; record exact CPU/GPU model
required_behavior.randomness: seed Python, NumPy, Torch CPU, and every available accelerator from the cell seed; graph control uses only graph_seed 20260905
required_behavior.determinism: request deterministic Torch algorithms, set cuDNN deterministic true and benchmark false when applicable, and record any unsupported operation
required_behavior.precision: float32 training and inference for every learned arm; float64 only for metric accumulation and statistical analysis
required_behavior.timing: synchronize the accelerator immediately before and after timed regions; exclude data download and one-time preprocessing
required_behavior.memory: record peak process host memory and peak allocated accelerator memory when applicable
required_behavior.threading: record CPU logical/physical counts and Torch intra/inter-op thread counts

lock_gate: before pilot, write exact interpreter, package lock, hardware, driver, deterministic settings, and hashes to the pilot manifest; formal execution must reuse that verified lock
known_limit: the authoring snapshot is CPU-only and has not run the proposed pilot; it is not formal runtime evidence
